items.followUp: What is agriculture, and how is it different from horticulture?

rubric.why: Horticulture concerns cultivating garden crops, including fruits, vegetables and ornamental plants.
rubric.description: Defines horticulture as the cultivation of garden crops or gives suitable examples of those crops.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the cultivation of garden crops or naming suitable examples in this context.

rubric.why: Horticulture is a specialized branch of agriculture.
rubric.description: States that horticulture is a branch or part of agriculture.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating its relationship to agriculture.

modelAnswer: Horticulture is the cultivation of garden crops, such as fruits, vegetables and ornamental plants.
It is a branch of agriculture.

items.followUp: What is endocytosis? Give one function.

rubric.why: Exocytosis occurs when a vesicle fuses with the cell membrane.
rubric.description: Defines exocytosis as the fusion of a vesicle with the plasma or cell membrane.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing vesicle fusion with the cell membrane.

rubric.why: Exocytosis releases contents outside the cell and is important in secretion and waste removal.
rubric.description: States that exocytosis releases substances outside the cell or gives a valid importance such as secretion or waste removal.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating outward release or one valid function.

modelAnswer: Exocytosis is the process in which a vesicle fuses with the plasma membrane and releases its contents outside the cell.
It is important for secretion of substances and removal of wastes from the cell.

items.followUp: State two advantages of classifying organisms.

rubric.why: Classification groups organisms to make their study easier.
rubric.description: States that classification arranges organisms into groups or makes organisms easier to study.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for mentioning organized grouping or easier study.

rubric.why: Classification helps identify organisms and understand their similarities, differences and relationships.
rubric.description: States that classification helps identify organisms or understand similarities, differences or relationships among them.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for one valid additional aim of classification.

modelAnswer: Classification arranges organisms into groups, making them easier to study.
It helps in identifying organisms and understanding their similarities, differences and relationships.
